title: File:Mae Tia Waterfall, Op Luang National Park.jpg
author: Catchiangmai
description: Mae Tia Waterfall, a magnificent cascading waterfall set within the verdant forest of Op Luang National Park, Chiang Mai, Thailand. The image captures the natural beauty of the waterfall as it flows down the rocky cliff, complemented by the lush surrounding vegetation and the clear signage at the site.
